findings.issue: Vacuum sealing alone does not prevent bacterial growth; reduced-oxygen packaging requires time/temperature controls and may create C. botulinum risk.
The claim that most temperatures above 55 C are above where bacteria can grow is overgeneralized and not a validated universal safety threshold.
Low-temperature fish is not generally proven safe by good sourcing alone; parasites, pathogens and time/temperature controls matter.
